name: Kujou Kururi
source:
Kururi is a genius inventor who has invented a robot named Maxx. She is in the year below [url=/c804]Shou[/url]. She acts quite cold towards Shou but acts really nicely around people that she knows and/or respects. She is good friends with [url=/c14681]Megumi[/url].

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/24/flyable-heart-review/]Liemyx's review[/url]]
